faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Programme Administrator post at IIM Nagpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Assistant Programme Administrator position at IIM Nagpur is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Assistant Programme Administrator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess at least a Graduation degree. A Master's degree is preferred for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Programme Administrator post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Assistant Programme Administrator position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this post will primarily involve an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Programme Administrator post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is an appropriate pay level as per the 7th Pay Commission, ensuring competitive compensation.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Programme Administrator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Programme Administrator position at IIM Nagpur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the required experience for the Assistant Programme Administrator role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 6 years of overall experience is required, with at least 3 years in academic administration within a Higher Education or Management Institution.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions, so candidates from other states may be eligible if they meet the other criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: The official notification and application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
